## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and what changes for users. Link the related issue or backlog ticket.

## Verification

List checks run and their results, plus any unverified behavior or limitations.
For protocol changes, identify fixture provenance and recovery scenarios covered.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and fits ArbSync's detection-only scope.
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression tests, or I explained why tests do not apply.
- [ ] Relevant checks in CONTRIBUTING.md passed, or failures/skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] User-facing documentation reflects the final behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, runtime databases, or raw live-run artifacts are included.
- [ ] I followed CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and the Apache-2.0 contribution terms.
